name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
title: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd - 543498 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Revenue up ~33% YoY on volume, but copper pass-through lag (3–6 months) compresses margins; greenfield plants ramping unevenly with Pune at ~40–50% utilisation; FY27 capex ~INR200 crores, demand-linked.

utilisation.quote: our existing plants, they are running around 80% of capacity utilization at this moment

capex.peers_comment: Management referred to OEMs announcing their own expansions, not to competitor capacity.
capex.quote: It will be largely in line with what we have incurred in the current year, approximately INR200 crores.

triggers.label: Pune greenfield utilisation ~40–50%
triggers.quote: that was coming around 40% to 50%, but we have to see how if the volumes comes up again

triggers.label: Copper pass-through 3–6 month lag
triggers.quote: Largely, our customers falls in a 3 -month bracket, but there are a few customers where the 6-month arrangements are also there.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR200 crores, customer-backed
triggers.quote: It will be largely in line with what we have incurred in the current year, approximately INR200 crores.

triggers.label: Revenue growth ~33% vs market single digit
triggers.quote: we have grown with around 33% on the sales revenue and the market has grown in the s ingle digit

guidance.quote: as we have projected earlier also that it will be in the tune of around INR2,000 crores on the annualized basis.
It will be largely in line with what we have incurred in the current year, approximately INR200 crores.

guidance.value: Cost increase in Q4 to be offset in Q1 volumes via pass-through
guidance.quote: the increase, which is there in the quarter 4, we would be able to offset in the quarter 1 volumes.

red_flags.label: Greenfield plants ramping below plan; Pune ~40–50%
red_flags.quote: Pune location, whereas the volumes has not gone to the forecasted number. So it is approximately 50%.

red_flags.label: Evasive on greenfield plant margins and capex nature
red_flags.quote: We don't go by margin. We are a ROCE focused company

red_flags.label: Customer-side volume shortfalls and delayed model launches
red_flags.quote: the customer has also postponed their project launch also model launch also. So it has gone delayed.

evasions.quote: we don't go plant-by-plant profitability in that way.

evasions.topic: Copper/commodity volume split and BOM breakdown
evasions.quote: We normally don't do that because it's quite a fluid situation
We are not allowed to disclose the exact programs of our customers.

evasions.topic: Plan B for underutilised EV plants
evasions.quote: we're always looking at bringing different customers into those locations.
